data.title: Un-Cover Tortuga Event Pass: Break the Siege (Nov 25–Dec 8)
data.meta_title: Un-Cover Tortuga Event Pass: Break the Siege (Nov 25–Dec 8)
data.content:
Tortuga has erupted into open conflict, and Pilots are turning to retrofitted classics to survive its dense urban battlegrounds. From concussive blasts to rooftop-clearing volleys, the Un-Cover Tortuga Event Pass delivers gear built to break defenses and flush enemies from cover.

Running from November 25 to December 8, Un-Cover Tortuga brings powerful equipment and stylish customization options to help you take control of the battlefield.

Un-Cover Tortuga Event Pass Rewards (Free & Premium)

Unleash heavy firepower with the Zenit, a rocket launcher that rains devastating volleys along a high-arching trajectory. Take command of chokepoints with Kinetic Pulse, a Supply Gear device that sticks to surfaces or robots and fires shockwaves that scatter enemies in all directions.

Collect Intel, Credits, and Salvage—vital resources used to upgrade modules, weapons, and gear, or to craft brand-new equipment.

Recruit two new Pilots to your hangar:

  • Sarah Ali (Common Pilot): The Blood Lust Ace Talent increases rate of fire by 7% if any enemy is within 200m.
  • Emma James (Hero Pilot): Her Ghost Visor marks enemies when hit—revealing them, making them easier to target, and increasing damage taken by 4% for 6 seconds (16-second cooldown).

Show off your style with a collection of pirate-themed Stickers—including Jolly Kraken, Anchor, X Marks The Spot, and Brace Yerselves!

Complete the look with the Galleon Wrap for your mech—though fair warning: broadsides not included.

Prepare your hangar, Pilots. The siege begins November 25.
